panel.title: Care home panel
panel.overLimit: The care home has more than {{limit}} active residents. Contact ETNARA to review your plan. Nothing is blocked.
panel.modulesNote: ETNARA turns modules on when they are ready for your care home.

staffHours.title: Staff hours
staffHours.description: Record and approve hours worked, keep each person's pay rate and prepare an estimated pay calculation per period.
staffHours.estimateNotice: Amounts are estimates. They are not payroll or payment processing: ETNARA does not calculate taxes, deductions or contributions and does not move money.
staffHours.adminOnlyTitle: This section is for administrators only.
staffHours.adminOnlyDetail: Staff hours and pay rates are handled by a care home administrator.
staffHours.loadFailed: Hours or rates could not be loaded.
staffHours.periodUnavailableDetail: ETNARA could not confirm the summary with the server. Hours stay visible, but closing and exporting are blocked until it is recovered.
staffHours.missingRateDetail: Without a pay rate, the estimated pay for those hours is $0.
staffHours.periodDetail: Groups the approved hours and the estimated pay for the period.
staffHours.historyUnavailable: We could not load the history of closed periods. The figures above are confirmed.
staffHours.resolveFirst: Resolve pending or disputed timesheets before closing the period.
staffHours.confirmClose: Close the period from {{from}} to {{to}}? It will be recorded as closed.
staffHours.errorOverlap: That period overlaps one already closed: a timesheet is already in another period.
staffHours.errorClose: The period could not be closed on the server. Check that there are no exceptions.
staffHours.ratesDetail: Each person's hourly pay rate; it is used for the estimated pay when hours are approved. Only the care home administration sees it.
staffHours.invalidRate: Enter a valid amount (0 to 1,000 USD).
staffHours.errorRate: The rate could not be saved.

establishments.title: Facilities and rooms
establishments.description: Units, rooms, beds and resident placement for each facility.
establishments.emptyDetail: Create them in Settings → Facilities. The “General” unit is created automatically.

occupancy.overCapacity: At least one room has more residents than registered beds. This is only a notice: nothing is blocked.
occupancy.disclaimer: Beds registered by the care home. This is not the capacity authorized by the Department of the Family.

units.title: Units and rooms
units.hint: Rooms can go directly in “General”. Additional units (floors, wings or sections) are optional.

residents.title: Resident placement
residents.empty: There are no active residents in this facility.

geofence.title: Geofence
geofence.explain: It will only be used when clocking in to mark “inside” or “outside”: it never blocks a clock-in, does not track and does not store people's location.
geofence.centerError: Enter a valid latitude and longitude, or leave both empty.
geofence.reasonHint: Every change is recorded with its author and reason.

closure.title: Close facility
closure.explain: Archives the facility with its units and rooms. Nothing is deleted. It requires no active residents, current or future shifts or active assignments.
closure.cannot: It cannot be closed yet: resolve the items above first.
closure.willArchive: The facility, its units and rooms and the staff links to it will be archived. Nothing is deleted and it cannot be undone from the portal.

dialogs.name: Name
dialogs.generalHint: “General” can be renamed, but not archived while it has active rooms.
dialogs.unitHint: For example: Upper floor, North wing.
dialogs.unitActiveRooms: It has {{count}} active room(s): archive or move them first.
dialogs.bedsError: A whole number greater than 0, or empty.
dialogs.roomHasResidents: It has residents: move them before archiving it.
dialogs.fullWarning: All registered beds in this room are already occupied. You can still save: this is only a notice.

toasts.placedOver: Placement saved. Notice: the room exceeds its registered beds.

settings.closureRequired: Care home facilities are not archived here. Use Care home → Facilities and rooms → “Close facility”, which checks residents, shifts and assignments before closing it.

errors.fallback: The change could not be saved.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_NAME_TAKEN: There is already an active unit or room with that name in this facility.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_UNIT_HAS_ACTIVE_ROOMS: Archive or move this unit's active rooms first.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_ROOM_HAS_RESIDENTS: The room has active residents. Move them before archiving it.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_ROOM_LOCATION_IMMUTABLE: A room cannot move to another facility.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_ROOM_LOCATION_MISMATCH: The room belongs to another facility.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_CLOSURE_REQUIRED: Care home facilities are closed with “Close facility” (Care home → Facilities and rooms).
errors.RESIDENTIAL_TRANSFER_ACTIVE_SHIFTS: The resident has current or future shifts in their current facility. Cancel or reassign them before transferring the resident to another facility.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_CLOSURE_FUTURE_SHIFTS: There are current or future shifts in this facility. Cancel them before closing it.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_CLOSURE_ACTIVE_ASSIGNMENTS: There are active assignments in this facility.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_CLOSURE_ACTIVE_RESIDENTS: There are active residents in this facility. Transfer or discharge them before closing it.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_REASON_REQUIRED: Write the reason for the change.
errors.RESIDENTIAL_MANAGER_REQUIRED: Only the care home administration can make this change.
errors.INVALID_INPUT: Check the data: a value is not valid.
